services: We take care of your car
about: I had numerous scratches on my 4*4 on all 4 doors (one being a LARGE scratch about 30 cms times 2 cm wide from a hit and run) and when I asked for quotes from Max or Nissan they quoted me more than AED 4000 !! I approached Zain Care who handled it so professionally and timely for less than AED 2000 – that shows value for money and customer loyalty ! I highly recommend Zain !

Well its rare to get good customer service in Dubai from my experience and even rarer to get top quality work. I had small dents and scratches on all of the doors on my BMW and spoke to the dealer about having it repaired and was quoted a small fortune by them.
